summary.zh: 把社交平台讨论整理成可溯源报告
summary.en: Turn social posts into a cited, traceable evidence report.

description.zh: 按固定流程记下发现了什么、实际看了哪些内容、每条说法对应哪份材料，并标出重复转载和取不到的部分。适合比较产品在不同平台的口碑，或核查已有社交调研的引用是否站得住。有浏览器或用户提供的导出文件时效果更完整。
description.en: Records what was discovered, what was actually inspected and which evidence backs each claim, including duplicate reposts and access gaps. Use it to compare platform discussion or audit a social report. Browsing or supplied exports help.
